primary_gate: accuracy paired lower CI > 0 against both controls, and Brier/regret lower against both; task gains required, label fit alone insufficient
component_fit: all observed cells during presentation-event cycles; not only targeted cells; unconditional-surface control uses identical components
hypothesis_coupling: estimated from offline training H and effective-red-action-derived surface labels; never from test labels
caveat: surface states encode induced region, not a full fictitious operational hypothesis; relationship can be red-policy specific
event_scope: shared across cells within cycle; independent across cycles
